scenario: `/` always produces Float, even Int / Int (LEXP.7.4 / LEXP.12.2 — Python 3 semantics): 7 / 2 == 3.5, not 3. The inline guard `(t.a / t.b) == 3.5` over two Int slots fires only if division yields the Float 3.5; an integer division (3) would not match. Pins the true-division result type at runtime (the compiler-side LEXP.7.4 fixture only checks lowering). Use `//` for floor division.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: Int mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.a / t.b) == 3.5
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
